units.source_text: 渔夫打鱼回来，送些贝类与公子佐膳。

en.t: The fisherman returned from fishing and brought some shellfish to accompany the young lord's meal.

units.source_text: 公子与宰相便召唤他进来，问他长年的海边生活情状。

en.t: The young lord and the counselor then called him in and asked him about his many years of life by the sea.

units.source_text: 这渔夫便向两位贵客申诉身世中种种苦况。

en.t: The fisherman told the two noble guests of the many hardships he had endured in his life.

units.source_text: 虽然语无伦次，声如鸟啭，然而为生活操心这一点，都是一样的。

en.t: Though his words were disordered and his voice sounded like birdsong, his worries over making a living were the same as anyone else's.

units.source_text: 故公子与宰相听了，深觉可怜，便拿些衣服送与这渔夫。

en.t: So when the young lord and the counselor heard him, they felt deep pity and gave the fisherman some clothing.

units.source_text: 渔夫受赐，不胜荣幸之感。

en.t: The fisherman received the gifts and was overcome with a sense of honor.
